why: npx tsc greet.ts reported error TS2345 (greet(42): a number passed to name: string) and 'Found 1 error', but tsc still emits JavaScript by default, so greet.js exists and node greet.js prints 'Hello, 42!'. The point of the step is a typed name that compiles; the compile failed its type check, and the editor still shows ⊗ 1. Fix the call (a string) and compile again.

step.title: Compile greet.ts and run it
step.instructions: In the terminal, run npx tsc greet.ts. tsc prints nothing when the types check and writes greet.js next to greet.ts. Then run node greet.js: it prints the greeting.
hints: tsc prints nothing when it succeeds.
common_mistakes: Passing a number to a parameter typed string.

Terminal: greet.ts:5:19 - error TS2345: Argument of type 'number' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'.
